description.zh: 人建卡、Agent 认领执行、人验收的任务看板：五列流转、定时执行、Worktree 隔离与验收清单，配一套柔和纸张视觉。
description.en: A human-in-the-loop task board: humans create cards, agents claim and execute them, humans accept. Five-column flow, scheduled runs, worktree isolation and acceptance checklists, with a soft-paper visual system.
